title: Best Phones Under $500 in 2026
metaDescription: Compare the best smartphones under $500 in 2026. Pixel 10a, iPhone 17e, Galaxy A17, and Moto G Power with verified specs and analysis.
intro: Compare the best smartphones under $500 in 2026 — four phones that deliver excellent value across different ecosystems and price points.
quickVerdict: The Pixel 10a at $499 offers the best overall value with excellent cameras and 7 years of updates. The iPhone 17e at $599 is over budget but worth considering for iOS users. The Galaxy A17 at $199 is the best ultra-budget option. The Moto G Power at $299 excels in battery life.

keyDifferences.interpretation: This comparison covers phones from $199 to $599, showing what's available at each budget level.
The Pixel 10a has the best camera system in this price range with dual lenses and Google's computational photography.
The Moto G Power has the largest battery at 6,000mAh, followed by the Pixel 10a at 5,100mAh.
The Pixel 10a offers 7 years of OS and security updates — the longest in this comparison.
The Pixel 10a has the smoothest display with 120Hz refresh rate on an OLED panel.

practicalImplications: For most users, the Pixel 10a at $499 is the best overall package. If you're on a tight budget, the Galaxy A17 at $199 offers incredible value. If battery life is your priority, the Moto G Power at $299 is hard to beat. iOS users should consider the iPhone 17e despite its higher price.

faq.question: What is the best phone under $500?
faq.answer: The Google Pixel 10a at $499 is the best phone under $500 in 2026. It offers excellent cameras with dual-lens system, a smooth 120Hz OLED display, 5,100mAh battery, and 7 years of software updates.

faq.question: What is the best cheap phone under $200?
faq.answer: The Samsung Galaxy A17 5G at $199 is the best phone under $200. It offers an AMOLED display, 5G connectivity, and 6 years of security updates — exceptional value at this price.

faq.question: Is the iPhone 17e worth it over the Pixel 10a?
faq.answer: Only if you specifically want iOS. The Pixel 10a offers better hardware (cameras, battery, display) at $100 less. The iPhone 17e's main advantage is access to iOS and Apple's ecosystem.

faq.question: Which budget phone has the best battery life?
faq.answer: The Motorola Moto G Power 2026 has the largest 6,000mAh battery in this comparison, providing the longest battery life. It also supports wireless charging, which is rare at this price point.

faq.question: How long do budget phones last?
faq.answer: The Pixel 10a offers 7 years of software updates, matching flagship phones. The Galaxy A17 offers 6 years of security updates. The Moto G Power offers 2 years of OS updates and 3 years of security updates. Software support duration is a key factor in long-term value.
